slots.notes: Fullscreen looping background video behind all content (absolute inset-0, object-cover so it crops to any viewport); native asset is a cinematic dark-blue Earth-from-space shot. autoPlay muted loop playsInline.
Nav logo mark, w-8 h-8, sits left of the wordmark. Native art is a 4-quarter-circle leaf glyph rendered as an inline SVG path (viewBox 0 0 480 480), single-color white fill.
Trailing icon inside the LOG IN gradient pill (native: Lucide ArrowRight, w-4 h-4, white on the emerald-to-cyan gradient).
Open/close glyph pair for the mobile hamburger that cross-fades with rotation (native: Lucide Menu and X).
Social row under the footer CONNECT heading (native: Lucide Facebook, Twitter, Dribbble, Youtube, Linkedin, Instagram; w-4 h-4, white/50 hover white).

mechanic: A single static min-h-screen flex column (nav / centered 404 hero / multi-column footer) layered over a fullscreen looping background video, with glassmorphism on the CTA and a staggered cross-fading mobile menu.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS + Lucide React icons (with two custom CSS classes, .four-oh-four glow and .liquid-glass border-gradient).
reskinNotes: Logo art is a hardcoded inline SVG path (no asset URL), so swapping the mark means replacing markup. All copy (NEXOVA, nav labels, 404 lines, footer columns, newsletter) is hardcoded in JSX. The emerald-400-to-cyan-500 accent gradient is baked into Tailwind utility classes (bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-cyan-500), not CSS variables, so retinting requires editing class strings in nav, mobile menu, and newsletter button. The .four-oh-four glow and .liquid-glass effect use literal white rgba values in custom CSS. The bg color is not a declared solid hex — the visual background IS the video; #000000 is only the natural dark fallback. The design uses a non-default 'xs' Tailwind breakpoint that must be registered or remapped to 'sm'.
